notes.content:

For a limited time, you can get all Cleverweek Games, (including DLC), for just $1.49 on Bundle Stars!

The deal is called the [url=https://www.bundlestars.com/en/bundle/swift-bundle]Swift Bundle[/url], and it will be available for 13 days from now.

What is more, if you buy this bundle, you can get our upcoming game for $1.40 off during launch week, for just $3.59! To claim this discount, go to [url=http://store.steampowered.com/bundle/469/]this link[/url] between Nov. 3 - Nov. 9.

Thanks, and enjoy!
The Cleverweek Team

notes.content:

Three Digits follows the same rules as Two Digits, but there are 14 numbers and the range is 1-999.

The store page can be found using the following link:

notes.title: Now with remastered levels!
notes.content:
Hello community!

So we have replaced all levels from 16 - 249 that contained solutions of the following forms:

[list]
    [*]x = x
    [*]x + y = z
    [*]x + y = z + w
[/list]

Also, the "Even" pack was replaced with a new pack, named "Two Digits Only". It contains levels with numbers 10 - 99.

So it is time to start playing Two Digits remastered edition!
